description: Explicit broad checkpoint over the unchanged 1000-row fixture. Original pre-sharing source versus final source, same schedules across APIs and runtimes. Covers cheap lookup/scalar, scan, grouped HAVING, ordering, many groups, DISTINCT, mixed scalar types, PK-equality self-join with residual predicate, all six new wildcard targets and two LIKE controls. Cross-core adapters validate rendered-value checksums/row counts and use their existing collectors; Ruby binding comparison separately validates exact values, metadata and costs while externally draining query cursors.

workloads.name: scalar
workloads.sql: SELECT abs($1::i64) + 7

workloads.name: pk_hit
workloads.sql: SELECT score FROM items WHERE id = $1

workloads.name: pk_miss
workloads.sql: SELECT score FROM items WHERE id = $1

workloads.name: filtered_scan
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items WHERE score >= $1 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: aggregate
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE bucket = $1

workloads.name: group_having
workloads.sql: SELECT bucket, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY bucket HAVING sum(score) > $1 ORDER BY sum(score) DESC, bucket

workloads.name: sort_limit
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY score DESC, id LIMIT 20

workloads.name: arithmetic_projection
workloads.sql: SELECT id, (score::i64 * 3 + bucket::i64) / (bucket::i64 + 1) FROM items WHERE bucket >= $1 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: case_projection
workloads.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN score >= $1 THEN score::i64 * 3 + bucket::i64 ELSE -score::i64 END FROM items ORDER BY id

workloads.name: aggregate_many_groups
workloads.sql: SELECT score % 100, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY score % 100 ORDER BY 1

workloads.name: aggregate_distinct
workloads.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT bucket), sum(DISTINCT bucket) FROM items

workloads.name: mixed_scalar
workloads.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN $1::i64 BETWEEN -1000 AND 0 THEN coalesce(nullif($1::i64, -7), 3) ELSE abs($1::i64) END AS n, (12.5::decimal / 2::decimal)::text AS d, 'é' || 'x' AS t

workloads.name: indexed_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.label, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

workloads.name: like_underscore_prefix
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row_5%'

workloads.name: like_fixed_width
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row___'

workloads.name: like_interior_percent
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'r%w%5%'

workloads.name: like_not_interior_percent
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM items WHERE label NOT LIKE 'r%w%5%'

workloads.name: like_wildcard_projection
workloads.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN label LIKE 'row__%' THEN score + 1 ELSE score - 1 END FROM items ORDER BY id

workloads.name: like_wildcard_group
workloads.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN label LIKE 'r%w%5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY CASE WHEN label LIKE 'r%w%5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY 1

workloads.name: text_like_fallback
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row5%'

workloads.name: like_mixed_fallback
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row%_5%'
